[Mouser Electronics](https://www.mouser.com/?srsltid=AfmBOopgYfVIMWIttD4SZ5f6UyJ7E-EqwdKiFGWV7G_EeCVjHyhPkqGW) sells over 6.8 million authorized electronic components and industrial automation products from more than 1,200 manufacturer brands. Their inventory includes semiconductors, passives, interconnects, electromechanical parts, sensors, and embedded tools for design engineers and buyers. [](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mouser-electronics)

- **Semiconductors:** Microcontrollers, processors, integrated circuits, and diodes.

- **Passive components:** Resistors, capacitors, inductors, and transformers.

- **Electromechanical parts:** Switches, relays, connectors, and motor drives.

- **Sensors and IoT:** Wireless modules, thermal management, and embedded development boards.

- **Industrial automation:** Control products, power supplies, and test equipment. [](https://www.quora.com/What-does-the-company-Mouser-Electronics-do)
